items.content_html: Slumber is a Chrome extension that suspends inactive tabs to reclaim memory and reduce CPU usage. When a tab is suspended, it is replaced with a lightweight sleeping page that preserves the tab's title, favicon, and original URL. The user can restore the tab at any time with a single click or keypress.
